interpretations: Eight worlds and twelve event studies, artistically reinterpreted from the Unity source.

recordings.name: MASSIVE / attract orb
recordings.note: The attract-screen surface folds through its full motion cycle. Original ATTRACT capture; edited loop.

provenance.edit: Native source frames 0–599, forward at 30fps. Whole object framed with a fixed crop.
provenance.loop: Native 20-second shader cycle. Forward playback; no dissolve or reversal.
provenance.isolation: Only the live AttractFerrofluidStudy surface is visible; the recording camera uses the authored lettering basis.
provenance.compatibility: Temporary capture copy only: uniform 4× tessellation avoids a Metal hull-stage texture-binding failure; explicit lettering-size uniforms and the provided arrival recording clock restore the authored title. Native surface, lettering and motion parameters retained.

recordings.name: Resonance / whole field
recordings.note: The whole field bends around a living pattern. Original DYNAMO capture; edited loop.

provenance.loop: 0.80s wrap dissolve using source footage; no reversal.
provenance.isolation: Grid and live Resonance hierarchy only. Portrait recording camera looks down the arena length. HUD and unrelated actors are hidden; scripted movement still deforms the field.

recordings.name: Maximum amplification
recordings.note: The third accepted goal takes Dark to ×8. The boundary carries the charge. Original DYNAMO capture; repeats with a cut.

provenance.loop: Forward edit; repeats with a cut.
provenance.control: Input-driven scoring drill. Dark pursues and strikes each core; Light circles the arena. No forced captures, transforms or multiplier changes.
provenance.acceptedEvent: Accepted goals at 12.800s (×2), 34.067s (×4) and 53.700s (×8); native maximum verified at 59.733s.
provenance.goalEffect: Saved shared Amplifier treatment; native score level, no effect preview or parameter boost.

recordings.name: NOVA in play
recordings.note: Players and particles move through the changing arena. Original NOVA capture; repeats with a cut.

provenance.control: Scripted movement and attack button input; native collisions, mechanics and effects. No transform animation or forced gameplay result.
provenance.edit: Frames 300–539, forward at 30 fps. Fixed crop per format; native colour. Repeats with a cut.

recordings.name: ORBITAL cloud
recordings.note: The live probability cloud, isolated from the grid and other gameplay layers. Original ORBITAL capture; edited loop.

provenance.loop: 0.60s wrap dissolve using source footage; no reversal.
provenance.isolation: ORBITAL Cloud hierarchy only; unrelated grid, Resonance and immediate-mode gameplay drawings excluded from the recording camera.

recordings.name: DYNAMO field
recordings.note: A close view of the live map’s moving field lines. Original DYNAMO capture; edited loop.

provenance.edit: Frames 540–719, forward at 30 fps. Fixed crop per format; native colour.  Short wrap dissolve added to close the visual loop.
provenance.loop: 0.80s wrap dissolve between actual source frames; native forward motion, no reversal.

recordings.name: How to play

provenance.loop: Forward edit; repeats with a cut.
provenance.isolation: The gameplay HUD root is hidden in the isolated capture session. Native instruction text and demonstrations are retained.
